name: IC Interface USB — USB, I2C — DFN
description: Surface-mount USB interface IC cluster supporting USB and I2C protocols in a DFN package family.
selection_hints: Verify compatibility with DFN package family and DFN-10-1EP footprints.
Confirm requirement for USB and I2C interface facets.
Select Tier A quality entries from KiCad symbol sources such as FT200XD.
avoid_when: The PCB design requires through-hole components rather than surface mount.
Packages other than DFN are required for layout.
The application does not require USB or I2C interfaces.
